name: Strong Hire: answer conduct check (IV-12)
description: Does a candidate turn belong in the interview (ok), go outside it (off_scope, including prompt injection), or abuse (inappropriate)? Hand-written turns placed after a real interviewer question. The product's rule is 'when in doubt, ok', so a false off_scope on a weak answer is the costly error: slice by expected. Prompts are Strong Hire's own (built by scripts/build_strong_hire.py); a model with prompt_tier small gets the small-model variant where the row has one.
